transcript.note: Round 1, laid out from scratch off the working map. Frame first (criterion 1): I placed the 65 points of degree 3+ by reading each one's neighbour bearings off gx/gy and reproducing that cyclic order on the grid, working outward from the Circle-line core - Paddington 5 / Edgware Rd 25 / Baker St 90 pulled onto one row (37), King's Cross 33 as the seven-way hub at col 51, Bank 48 (seven-way) and Waterloo 44 (six-way) as the other anchors, Oxford Circus 64 and Green Park 68 (six-way each) between them. Waterloo and the crossing point 105 needed a second pass: 45 (Lambeth North) and 105 round to the same gx/gy but are genuinely 0.5 units apart, so cell-sharing deleted a bearing that the reference has. Splitting them onto 45=[54,17] and 105=[55,17] restores the true order at Waterloo (104, 45, 105, 21, 102, 107 anticlockwise) and buys three straight segments (44-45 vertical, 45-105 horizontal, 105-8 vertical). Then the degree 1-2 tails were run straight along their line's main direction (criterion 2): Metropolitan 56-57-58 and Northern 3-4 vertical, Heathrow 65-14-15 horizontal, Piccadilly 47-20 vertical, Central 16-66 vertical, District 75-35 horizontal, Jubilee 36-77 vertical, Circle 0-50 vertical, Northern 43-93 and 12-48-103-21 vertical. East-west and north-south rank order from gx/gy is kept for all but 20 of the 6328 point pairs (criterion 3), the exceptions being deliberate ties used to buy a straight segment (5/25, 20/47, 41/28, 75/35).
